name: Pocket Goal: World Cup 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Pocket Goal: World Cup is a fast-paced arcade foosball game where you control all four bars at once with a single swipe. Pick from 32 national teams, each with 5 unique kits, and compete in solo matches, local 1v1, online quick matches, or full tournaments with group stages and knockout rounds.
